heuristics.name: test-word register
heuristics.description: pick the option that looks most like a vocabulary-test target word / most general-purpose abstract word

heuristics.name: antonym-pair pole
heuristics.description: two options form an antonym pair; pick one pole (or, once, the outlier) on the assumption the key sits in the pair

heuristics.name: odd one out
heuristics.description: pick the option semantically different from the other three

heuristics.name: two-blank pair coherence
heuristics.description: pick the two-blank pair whose words relate in the most natural contrast/agreement

heuristics.name: shared first blank
heuristics.description: two options share a first word; pick one of those two

notes: Solver c. Single-blank vocabulary options carry little signal; most register picks are weak. reject_certain false for all: no option judged ruleable-out without the sentence.
